title: iOS app: cut upstream umbilical (EAS project, updates URL, owner) and rebuild
description:
Evidence: apps/mobile/app.json owner inbox-zero, extra.eas.projectId 07f7eb04-…, updates block; generated ios/Rakazo/Supporting/Expo.plist EXUpdatesEnabled=true CheckOnLaunch=ALWAYS EXUpdatesURL=https://u.expo.dev/07f7eb04-…; lib/push.ts:12 mints tokens against that project. Do: remove updates + extra.eas + owner from app.json; set expo-updates disabled (updates.enabled=false) so Expo.plist is regenerated with EXUpdatesEnabled=false; keep bundle com.czaku.rakazo; document that push is off until Luke owns an EAS project/APNs key; do NOT run the archive (needs GUI) — leave env: load .env

context.text: EAS umbilical cut: app.json owner/projectId/updates-url removed, updates.enabled=false; prebuild regenerated Expo.plist EXUpdatesEnabled=false, no u.expo.dev under ios/; bundle kept com.czaku.rakazo; push documented off pending Luke's EAS project+APNs key; mobile tests 230/230 green; commit 231d431 on lane/T-RKZ-006 (pushed)
